scope: Pinned RoboTwin 2.0 clean render and deterministic reset preflight
summary: Pinned RoboTwin source and 3.96 GB of clean embodiment/object assets now form an experiment-owned runtime; real SAPIEN rendering passes and two independent seed-0 resets are bit-exact while seed 1 changes the scene.
evidence: RoboTwin commit 266f3aadf505a4f7fe9af0faa41a20f5f47cd123 and asset revision c15cc97be71e35244b6605d2d84c187f8565cc4d are pinned.
The SAPIEN render preflight passed on physical A800 GPU 2 with an explicit Render Well marker.
Two new seed-0 environments have qpos/endpose/bottle maximum error 0, identical model/qpose tags, and identical head-RGB SHA-256.
Seed 1 changes the bottle functional point by 0.273676 m, changes model ID, and changes the head-RGB hash.
lessons: RoboTwin clean reset reproducibility is now measured rather than assumed.
Point-cloud, HDF5-save, and motion-planner stubs were restricted to setup-only preflight and are explicitly recorded; they are not valid for expert execution.
limitations: XPolicyLab and background textures are omitted.
The reset preflight does not execute expert actions or produce paired counterfactual rollouts.
next_actions: Install the official Curobo v0.7.8 stack and collect successful adjust_bottle expert seeds before building A+/A_swap replay.
